content: {"findings":[{"severity":"concern","file":"src/exporter.js","line":7,"message":"the catch arm swallows the write error and reports the batch as written, so a failed flush is indistinguishable from a successful one"},{"severity":"concern","file":"src/exporter.js","line":14,"message":"the cursor advances past a batch whether or not its write succeeded, so one failed batch is silently skipped for the rest of the drain"},{"severity":"concern","file":"src/exporter.js","line":22,"message":"clamp multiplies its arguments instead of bounding the offset, so any caller-provided offset outside the span corrupts the slice arithmetic"},{"severity":"concern","file":"src/summary.js","line":8,"message":"the total adds every batch again after a retry, so a retried batch is counted twice in the rollup"},{"severity":"concern","file":"src/summary.js","line":12,"message":"entries whose count is zero are dropped from the rendered list, which hides empty windows instead of showing them"}],"summary":"Five concern findings across the new exporter and its rollup helper."}
